name: grailwatch
description: Collectibles accumulation detector — scores quiet-accumulation probability nightly by finding price/volume movement that diverges from flat public attention

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @grailwatch/api run dev" "pnpm --filter @grailwatch/web run dev"
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @grailwatch/db run generate && pnpm --filter @grailwatch/db run migrate
